update.title:
/bin/sh -c 'if [ ! -d published ]; then
  echo '"'published directory does not exist' >&2
  exit 1
fi
mkdir -p rollback
find published -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec mv {} rollback/ +
rmdir published 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\\n' 'Moved files:' "'$(find rollback -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '"'%f\\n' | sort)"
